message:
## Vulnerability Digest

This primary product scan used only `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt`; obvious naming variants and duplicate entries were consolidated. The scan window was **2026-10-09 23:40 UTC through 2026-10-10 23:40 UTC** (**2026-10-10 05:10 IST through 2026-10-11 05:10 IST**).

No confirmed new vulnerability was found that both falls within the strict 24-hour window and maps directly to a product in the combined primary inventory. Current feeds contained vulnerabilities in adjacent vendor products and unlisted WordPress plugins, plus older disclosures resurfacing in new summaries; these were excluded after product and freshness checks.

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The mandatory dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, and official MongoDB libraries and integrations.

MongoDB's three Ops Manager records dated October 9—CVE-2026-87108, CVE-2026-87109, and CVE-2026-87110—were specifically checked. Their CVE publication timestamps are around 05:52 UTC on October 9, approximately 18 hours before this run's cutoff, so they were not reported as new in this digest. No other MongoDB-family finding could be verified within the window. Source: [MongoDB security alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts).

### Review priority

No immediate review is recommended based on newly reported, in-scope vulnerabilities during this window. Continue normal monitoring; older high-severity issues and current exploitation notices were not recast as new findings.
